name: billing-support-orchestrator
description: Manager agent for billing-migration support questions. Delegates query triage and documentation lookup to two specialists and returns a grounded, cited answer or an explicit refusal.

skills.name: Triage query
skills.description: Normalize error and plan codes, classify intent, rewrite the search query.

skills.name: Policy lookup
skills.description: Search the billing help-centre corpus and draft a cited answer.

skills.name: Draft reply
skills.description: Verify the draft against its sources and return the final grounded answer or refusal.
